name: jaml-language-support
description: Curate Balatro seeded runs with JAML: Motely.Lsp diagnostics, completion, and @jimbo chat (validate / find seeds / explain).

chatParticipants.name: jimbo
chatParticipants.description: JAML filters, Motely search, Balatro seed hunt

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate JAML with the Motely engine

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain a clause, root key, or enum name from Motely schema

disambiguation.description: The user wants help with JAML filters, Motely, Balatro seed search, or Jimbo Ante Markup Language.
examples: find a seed for this jaml filter
what does voucher Overstock mean in jaml
search balatro seeds with perkeo ante 1

languageModelTools.name: motely_validate_jaml
languageModelTools.userDescription: Validate JAML with the Motely engine loader
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Parse and validate a JAML Balatro seed filter with the real Motely engine (JamlConfigLoader via Motely.Lsp --diagnose). Use before search. Returns OK or a table of errors with line/column. Prefer absolute filePath to an open .jaml, or pass full jamlText. Do not invent diagnostics.

jamlText.description: Full JAML document text when not reading a file

filePath.description: Absolute path to a .jaml file on disk

languageModelTools.name: motely_search_seeds
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search for matching Balatro seeds with Motely
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run Motely.CLI seed search for a JAML filter (--collect N). Returns real seed strings and scores from the engine. Always validates JAML first. Prefer absolute filePath to a .jaml or full jamlText. collectN defaults to 1 (SIMD may return a few over). Never invent seeds. Local CPU only.

jamlText.description: Full JAML document text when not reading a file

filePath.description: Absolute path to a .jaml file on disk

collectN.description: Stop after about N matches (default 1, max 100)

languageModelTools.name: motely_explain_jaml
languageModelTools.userDescription: Explain a JAML clause or name from the Motely engine schema
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Explain a JAML discriminator, root key, enum value, or vocabulary query using Motely JamlSchema (e.g. joker, must, Perkeo, voucher Overstock). Returns markdown from the real engine. Do not invent clause keys.

topic.description: Word or short query: joker, must, pokerHand, Perkeo, joker blue

jaml.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the Motely.Lsp executable. Empty = bundled server/Motely.Lsp, else workspace `dotnet run --project Motely.Lsp`.

jaml.cliPath.description: Absolute path to Motely.CLI. Empty = bundled server/Motely.CLI, else workspace `dotnet run --project Motely.CLI`.

jaml.searchTimeoutMs.description: Kill Motely.CLI seed search after this many milliseconds (default 120s).

jaml.trace.server.description: Trace Motely.Lsp ↔ VS Code communication in the Output panel.
